messages:
Priya (Product): Quick capture from today's all-hands sec Q&A. Customers asked for a one-pager on BYOK rotation guarantees, HSM roadmap for Private, DSAR ownership language, and ISO evidence timing. Can we thread the answers here so I can share?
Leah (Head of Security): TL;DR incoming. I'll keep bullets short.
Priya (Product): Perfect.
Leah (Head of Security): BYOK/KMS: supported for Dedicated & Private. Recommended rotation cadence is 90d; we do not forcibly rewrap customer-managed keys. Managed rotation (automatic rewrap + audit) will be an opt-in service.
Sam (Privacy): Quick DSAR note: Hosted API customers: by default we keep request metadata; payloads are not stored unless customer enables retention. Private deployments: the customer controls data; DSAR responses are the customer's responsibility, though Redwood will provide export tooling and assistance per contract.
Kai (Eng-Infra): HSMs & on-prem: we plan a KMIP-based connector agent. HSM GA depends on pilot integrations and security sign-off. Pilot window = May-Jun; tentative GA = end of Q3.
Jordan (CTO): Confirming GA target end of Q3, contingent on two pilot customers completing integration and passing perf/security tests.
Anya (Compliance): ISO/SOC2 evidence: short roadmap - June: export templates; August: self-serve evidence bundles; Sept: auditor-access toggles. Dates tentative.
Priya (Product): Customers also asked whether we can produce immutable audit replicas.
Kai (Eng-Infra): We can stream audit logs to customer-owned buckets (S3/GCS) with versioning. Immutable/WORM semantics depend on the storage backend; we'll publish configuration recipes and recommended bucket policies.
Leah (Head of Security): Action items: (1) Leah -> publish BYOK FAQ + DSAR ownership paragraph; (2) Kai -> HSM pilot checklist + signup; (3) Anya -> ISO evidence timeline + example exports.
Priya (Product): Can we get internal links to drafts so I can circulate externally?
Kai (Eng-Infra): HSM design draft: https://internal.redwood/docs/hsm-connector (internal). Pilot form: https://forms.redwood/hsm-pilot (internal).
Leah (Head of Security): BYOK FAQ draft: https://internal.redwood/docs/byok-faq (internal).
Anya (Compliance): ISO evidence checklist draft: https://internal.redwood/docs/iso-evidence (internal).
Priya (Product): Please file follow-up tickets so we can track these workstreams.
reminders-bot: Created ticket SEC-602 "BYOK FAQ & DSAR policy" and SEC-603 "HSM connector pilot checklist".
Leah (Head of Security): I'll own SEC-602.
Kai (Eng-Infra): I'll pick up SEC-603 and start pilot outreach.
Anya (Compliance): I'll file SEC-604 for ISO evidence automation and link back here.
Sam (Privacy): Draft DSAR blurb for customers: "Hosted: Redwood retains request metadata; request/response content is not stored unless you opt in. Private/Dedicated: you control customer data and are responsible for DSAR responses; Redwood provides export tooling and limited contract-bound assistance."
Priya (Product): Great. I'll compile a short external FAQ once the drafts are live. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
Leah (Head of Security): Closing the loop. For NDA or detailed architecture requests, route via Legal/SE.
reminders-bot: Updated tickets: SEC-602 assigned to Leah, SEC-603 assigned to Kai, SEC-604 pending (Anya).
